significance: One of the holiest Vaishnava temples of India and a principal Divya Desam, at Chinna Kanchipuram; renovated by the Cholas in 1053 and enlarged through Vijayanagara times, its hundred-pillared hall is celebrated as a masterpiece of Vijayanagara architecture.
story: Vishnu is said to have blazed forth as Varadharaja from beneath the athi tree during Brahma's great sacrifice on this spot.
